summary: Sysco Corporation filed an 8-K announcing entry into a $3.0 billion revolving credit agreement (upsizable to $4.0B post-merger) and a $3.0 billion term loan agreement ($1.25B Tranche A + $1.75B Tranche B) to partially fund its pending acquisition of Jetro Restaurant Depot. The acquisition was previously announced in a March 30, 2026 8-K. The new credit facilities replace a prior $3.0B revolver and carry customary terms, with Tranche A maturing 364 days post-close and Tranche B two years post-close. Proceeds will also refinance JRD debt and pay transaction fees. Watch for completion of the acquisition required to upsize the revolver. Risk-arb: focus on regulatory clearance and JRD shareholder vote.
